facts.value: Your ASURITE User ID is the official login name you’ll use to access most ASU systems and services.
You’ll get your ASURITE User ID and activation instructions shortly after you submit your application.
A message from [email protected] with the subject line 'ASU Account Activation' will be sent to the email address you provided in your application.
If you can't remember your ASURITE User ID you can look it up at: asu.edu/lostpassword
Navigate to my.asu.edu, enter your ASURITE User ID and password, and click the 'Sign In' button to access your account.
You can view your priority tasks and next steps for enrollment, view your advisor contact information, view financial aid and billing information, and connect to campus technology and services.
After you enroll in classes, visit asu.edu/emailsignup to activate your official @asu.edu email address.
Once activated, you will access and check your official ASU email through your ASU Gmail account.
Be sure to check both your non-ASU personal email address and your ASU Gmail inbox regularly.
Download and save your admission letter for future reference.
